mapper.sql: select r.request_id, r.request_no, r.person_id, r.person_name, r.person_dept, r.matter_type, r.matter_desc, r.apply_dept, r.apply_contact, r.apply_doc_no, r.receive_date, r.deadline_days, r.status, r.suggest_result, r.final_result, r.reply_content, r.reply_date, r.reply_by, r.hit_count, r.warn_level, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark, case when r.receive_date is null or r.deadline_days is null then null else datediff(date_add(r.receive_date, interval r.deadline_days day), curdate()) end as remain_days from jc_reply_request r
mapper.select: select max(request_no) from jc_reply_request where request_no like concat(#{prefix}, '%')
mapper.insert: insert into jc_reply_request ( request_no, person_id, person_name, person_dept, matter_type, matter_desc, apply_dept, apply_contact, apply_doc_no, receive_date, deadline_days, status, create_by, create_time, remark, del_flag ) values ( #{requestNo}, #{personId}, #{personName}, #{personDept}, #{matterType}, #{matterDesc}, #{applyDept}, #{applyContact}, #{applyDocNo}, #{receiveDate}, #{deadlineDays}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark}, '0' )
mapper.update: update jc_reply_request set status = '1', suggest_result = #{suggestResult}, hit_count = #{hitCount}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where request_id = #{requestId} and status = '0'

update jc_reply_request set status = '2', final_result = #{finalResult}, reply_content = #{replyContent}, reply_date = #{replyDate}, reply_by = #{updateBy}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where request_id = #{requestId} and status = '1'
update jc_reply_request set status = '3', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where request_id = #{requestId} and status not in ('2','3')
mapper.delete: update jc_reply_request set del_flag = '1' where request_id = #{requestId}
mapper.select: select count(1) from jc_reply_request where del_flag = '0'
select count(1) from jc_reply_request where del_flag = '0' and status = '2'

select count(1) from jc_reply_request where del_flag = '0' and status not in ('2','3') and receive_date is not null and deadline_days is not null and date_add(receive_date, interval deadline_days day) < curdate()
select count(1) from jc_reply_request where del_flag = '0' and status = #{status}
select avg(datediff(reply_date, receive_date)) from jc_reply_request where del_flag = '0' and status = '2' and reply_date is not null and receive_date is not null

select dd.dict_label as name, count(1) as value from jc_reply_request r left join sys_dict_data dd on dd.dict_type = 'jc_reply_matter' and dd.dict_value = r.matter_type where r.del_flag = '0' group by r.matter_type, dd.dict_label, dd.dict_sort order by dd.dict_sort

select dd.dict_label as name, count(1) as value from jc_reply_request r left join sys_dict_data dd on dd.dict_type = 'jc_reply_conclusion' and dd.dict_value = r.final_result where r.del_flag = '0' and r.status = '2' group by r.final_result, dd.dict_label, dd.dict_sort order by dd.dict_sort

select date_format(r.receive_date, '%Y-%m') as name, count(1) as value from jc_reply_request r where r.del_flag = '0' and r.receive_date >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 11 month) group by date_format(r.receive_date, '%Y-%m') order by name

select r.person_dept as name, count(1) as value from jc_reply_request r where r.del_flag = '0' and r.person_dept is not null and r.person_dept != '' group by r.person_dept order by value desc limit 10

select r.request_id, r.receive_date, r.deadline_days, r.status, r.warn_level, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark, null as remain_days from jc_reply_request r where r.del_flag = '0' and r.status in ('0','1')
